_meta.title: Spicy Rodents wildlife & foraging data (extracted for Roblox rebuild)
_meta.units: HTML world units; multiply by 2.5 for Roblox studs. +Y up. Positions are world-space x,z (y = terrain/base height where given).
_meta.provenance: Static arrays are copied from code. Fields marked runtime:true were computed by executing the v5.4 / v4.1 code headlessly (seeded RNGs: neighborhood rng(20261008), livingRand rng(540811)); they are deterministic but should be spot-checked in the browser.

forage.note: In v5.4 none of these objects can be eaten or interacted with; they are set dressing. The Tabasco garden hides one chili spot and is meant to conceal the squirrel, but its concealment test never fires (see tabascoGarden.concealment).

concealment.note: Verifier: the test is player.pos.y < 2.4 (world y, 7035), but the ground inside |dx|<27,|dz|<15 is 3.9-5.7, so it can never trigger for a squirrel on the ground. Rebuild as height above ground.

hedgePatches.note: Verifier: only hedge (125,303) has ground (2.0-2.7) below the absolute 2.8 limit; the other four sit on ground 3.5-7.7 and never conceal.
